plugins.name: halyard
plugins.description: Shared team memory for AI agents. The halyard MCP server, skills (log-work, review-work, gather-context, ask-for-help, triage-knowledge, mark-terms), and a knowledge-first rule capture decisions, surface prior context, and route hard questions to teammates on Slack, Teams, or Discord.
